basic_info.description: Discover 49-51 Dorado Terrace, a rare opportunity in the desirable Mount Davidson Manor neighborhood. This ALL-VACANT property is perfect for multi-generational living or a savvy investment, offering flexibility and excellent rental income potential. It features two spacious flats, each with 3 bedrooms, 2 bathrooms, abundant natural light, updated flooring, and a remodeled top kitchen.    The top floor, Unit 51, includes a living room with a fireplace, a dining room with bay windows, a remodeled kitchen, 2 bedrooms plus a primary suite with an en suite bath, and skylights. The middle floor, Unit 49, mirrors this layout. The lower level features a legal 1-bedroom, playroom, 1-bathroom space with a living/dining area and wet bar. A 2-car independent garage adds to the convenience. Located near Ocean Avenue, Monterey Boulevard, and West Portal amenities, this property also offers easy access to Stern Grove, Mount Davidson, Balboa Park, CCSF, and SFSU. Highly rated schools nearby include CAIS, Lick Wilmerding, Riordan, Stratford, Waldorf and more. Whether you're an investor or owner-occupier seeking additional rental income, this property is an incredible opportunity in one of San Francisco's best-kept secret neighborhoods!
